chapter.v:
Let those
who do good shout for joy—those who live right should praise him!

Praise the
Lord with the lyre, play music to him on the ten-stringed harp.

Sing a
new song to him; play your instruments well and shout for joy.

For the
word of the Lord is true, and he is trustworthy in everything he does.

He loves
all that is good and right; the earth is full of the Lord's trustworthy love.

The Lord
spoke the word and the heavens were made; his mouth breathed all the stars into existence.

He gathers
the waters of the sea together, he keeps the ocean depths in store.

Let all
the earth show reverence to the Lord; let all the world's inhabitants be in awe of him.

For he
spoke and the world came into existence; he gave the command and it was created.

The Lord
foils the decisions of the nations, he frustrates the plans of the peoples,

But the
Lord's plan stands forever—what he decides lasts for all generations.

Happy is
the nation whose God is the Lord, the people he has chosen as specially belonging to him.

The Lord
looks from heaven and sees the whole of humanity,

from his
throne he watches all those who live on earth.

He created
their minds, so he knows everything they do.

Even the
greatest army cannot save a king; the greatest strength cannot save a warrior.

Don't deceive
yourself: a warhorse can't give you victory—even its incredible strength won't save you.

The Lord
watches over those who reverently follow him, those who place their hope in his trustworthy love

to save
them from death and to keep them alive when famine strikes.

We place
our confidence in the Lord; he is our help and our defender.

We are
so happy about him, for we trust in his holy character.

Lord, let
your trustworthy love rest upon us as we hope in you.
